about: Manual ambiguity flags for medical overlaps the automatic checks cannot see. Each flag is tied to the board signature it was raised on and lapses if the board changes.

gi-starter-3.text: "Pruritus" and "Jaundice" (obstructive cholestasis group) are also classic presenting clues of primary biliary cholangitis, which is on the same board; a player could reasonably place them in the PBC group.
